method: Full manual archaeology of upstream source at frozen revision. Evidence: oracle/upstream (frozen clone), oracle/upstream-v1.19.0-6b4a373.tar.gz (sha256 1e464db6..., deterministic git archive). Every surface below is quoted from source; every consequential behavior requires a court per docs/COURTS.md.

surfaces.value: QSharedMemory key 'CachyOS-KM-lock'; second instance exits with code -1 (255)
surfaces.notes: IsInstanceAlreadyRunning: create(1) fails -> attach+detach -> retry create; still fails => already running. Exit status -1 observed via shell as 255.

surfaces.value: bg ca cs de es it ja ko nl pl ru sk sv tr zh-CN (in qrc); uk.ts present but NOT in qrc
surfaces.notes: Ukranian translations ship in source but are never compiled into the resource. Qt .qm loading order: qt_<lang>, qt_<lang_TERRITORY>, app <lang>, app <lang_TERRITORY> from :/translations/ (aliases are bare lang codes).

surfaces.value: alpm_initialize("/", "/var/lib/pacman/")
mINI parse of /etc/pacman.conf; skip sections 'testing' and 'options'; every other section registered as syncdb with ALPM_SIG_USE_DEFAULT
surfaces.notes: NOT pacman's parser: mINI (src/ini.hpp) is case-insensitive, order-preserving (vector+index), '#' lines skipped, ';' comments, trailing ';' stripped on section lines. Include directives are NOT followed (a repo defined only inside an Include file is not registered). Section order preserved -> sync db order follows pacman.conf order. No SigLevel handling. This must be courted against real pacman behavior (docs/COURTS.md, pacman-config court).

surfaces.value: alpm_db_search regex 'linux[^ ]*-headers' per sync db; drop names containing 'linux-api-headers'; headers = db pkg with -headers name; kernel = same db pkg with '-headers' suffix removed; skip if kernel missing in same db
surfaces.notes: Output raw name: '<db>/<kernel>' e.g. 'cachyos/linux-cachyos'. Duplicates possible across dbs. HAVE_ALPM_INSTALLED_DB records alpm_pkg_get_installed_db provenance.

surfaces.value: substring search in order: lto->'lto optimized', lts->'longterm', zen->'zen-kernel', hardened->'hardened kernel', deckify->'handheld kernel', server->'server kernel', next->'next release', mainline->'mainline branch', git->'master branch', rc->'release candidate', else 'stable'
surfaces.notes: Order matters: substring, not prefix. 'linux-lts' hits lts before others.

surfaces.value: AUR -> 'unknown-version'. else sync version; if not installed -> sync version; if installed: vercmp(local, sync): 1 -> '∨<local>', -1 -> '∧<sync>' + update flag, 0 -> sync version
surfaces.notes: ∨ = U+2228 (down caret, downgrade marker), ∧ = U+2227 (up caret, update marker). Version column sorting strips these prefixes and compares with alpm_pkg_vercmp (km-window.cpp:391-412).

surfaces.value: linux-cachyos*: '{pkg}-zfs', '{pkg}-nvidia', '{pkg}-nvidia-open' in same db. linux/linux-lts: remove ALL 'linux' substrings from name -> 'nvidia[{-lts}]', 'nvidia-open[{-lts}]' in same db
surfaces.notes: remove_all replaces every occurrence of 'linux'. Only linux and linux-lts get the bare nvidia names.

surfaces.value: findmnt -ln -o FSTYPE / == 'zfs' exactly (exec at static-init time, once per process)
surfaces.notes: exec uses popen('/bin/sh -c ...'). Result cached at first use (static).

surfaces.value: chwd --list-installed -d 2>/dev/null | grep Name | awk '{print $4}' -> any profile name starts_with 'nvidia-dkms' / 'nvidia-open-dkms' (static, once); local db checks for nvidia-dkms / nvidia-open-dkms; pacman -Qqs '^linux-cachyos.*-nvidia$' / '^linux-cachyos.*-nvidia-open$'
surfaces.notes: Full decision matrix in docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. Prebuilt module preferred if already installed; else chwd profile; DKMS packages suppress prebuilt install; open takes precedence over closed when both somehow relevant.

surfaces.value: pacman -S --needed <install list> in escalated terminal; order [zfs?, nvidia?, kernel, headers]
surfaces.notes: install list built by Kernel::install(): zfs first if root-on-zfs && module known; then nvidia prebuilt if applicable && no dkms; then kernel name, then headers name. AUR kernels installed first via makepkg.

surfaces.value: pacman -Rsn <kernel + installed companions>; removal only if kernel is installed; companions (headers, zfs, nvidia, nvidia-open modules) appended only if installed locally
surfaces.notes: Order: kernel first, then headers, zfs, nvidia, nvidia-open.

surfaces.value: order: alacritty kitty ptyxis konsole kgx gnome-terminal xfce4-terminal lxterminal xterm st foot rio ghostty; $TERMINAL never read despite comment; command written to mktemp file, run as LAUNCHER_CMD "$file"; kgx gets 'kill -SIGQUIT $PPID' appended; no terminal -> notify-send 'No terminal installed' and exit 1
surfaces.notes: Quirk: final line `eval ... || [[ $terminal != kgx ]] && { rm "$file"; exit 2; }` parses as (eval||test)&&{...} so exit 2 also fires after successful terminal close (except kgx failure). Callers absorb: runCmdTerminal returns helper exit code; finished_proc keys on .done-status.

surfaces.value: terminal-helper -s 'pkexec /usr/lib/cachyos-kernel-manager/rootshell.sh' <cmd>; cmd gets '; read -p "Press enter to exit"' appended
surfaces.notes: Chain: terminal -> pkexec -> rootshell.sh -> /bin/bash -> script file. read -p keeps terminal open.

surfaces.value: popen(cmd, "r") — /bin/sh -c; on popen failure returns '-1'; strips exactly one trailing \n
surfaces.notes: All shell command strings are compatibility surfaces (findmnt, chwd, pacman -Qqs, paru, testscripts).

surfaces.value: ~/.cache/cachyos-km/pkgbuilds (linux-cachyos.git, branch master), ~/.cache/cachyos-km/aur_pkgbuilds/<pkg> (AUR git)
surfaces.notes: fix_path replaces ALL '~' with glib home dir. prepare_git_repo: dir without .git is removed entirely; clone; checkout --force master; git clean -fd; git pull. Branch hardcoded 'master'. NOTE: process cwd ends inside repo dir (never restored) — build path derives from it.

_cachy_config,_makenconfig,_makexconfig,_localmodcfg,_use_current,_cc_harder,_per_gov,_tcp_bbr3,_HZ_ticks,_tickrate,_preempt,_hugepage,_processor_opt,_use_llvm_lto,_build_zfs,_build_nvidia_open,_build_debug = yes/no or value; _processor_opt only when != manual; lto!=none && custom_name!='$pkgbase' -> _use_lto_suffix=n

surfaces.value: lto thin-dist only for non-lts/non-hardened; lto default thin for cachyos/rc else none; preempt Voluntary/None only for hardened/lts; preempt default lazy for server else full; hz default 300 for server else 1000; cachyconfig unchecked for server; builtin_zfs disabled+unchecked for rt
surfaces.notes: Switching kernel variant resets lto/preempt/hz/cachyconfig/zfs per these rules and refreshes patches tab.

surfaces.value: New source=() built from original entries (minus *.patch) + patch list (each quoted), inserted BEFORE prepare() at last \n; original source=() left in place (last assignment wins in bash)
surfaces.notes: No modification if prepare() or preceding newline missing. Local patches get 'file://' prefix when added via dialog. Patches tab shows only entries ending .patch from evaluated source array.

surfaces.value: pkgbase="<custom_name>" (with two leading \n) inserted before _major= at last \n; no-op if _major= missing
surfaces.notes: Default custom name field: '$pkgbase-custom'.

surfaces.value: makepkg -scf --cleanbuild --skipchecksums && touch .done-status  (non-escalated terminal; cwd = <app cwd>/<variant dir>)
surfaces.notes: Success marker = .done-status file, not exit code.

surfaces.value: PKGEXT from /etc/makepkg.conf (fallback .pkg.tar.zst); globs '<pkgfunc-suffix>-<pkgver>-<pkgrel>-*<PKGEXT>' from declare -F package_* functions; sudo pacman -U <globs>
surfaces.notes: pkgver-pkgrel read from sourced PKGBUILD echo 'pkgver: $pkgver-$pkgrel'. Uses sudo (not pkexec) inside non-escalated terminal.

surfaces.value: finished_proc keys on <build_path>/.done-status PRESENCE (not the exit code): present -> remove file + stdout 'success' + install question (Yes -> 'pressed yes', 'pacman_cmd := sudo pacman -U <globs>', m_running=true, re-entrant run_cmd_async); absent -> stderr 'process failed with exit code: <n>'. The re-entrant install's OWN completion sees the file gone -> 'process failed with exit code: 0' even on pacman success.
surfaces.notes: Courted by build-env/failure-lifecycle.

surfaces.value: on_execute: if (m_running) return; (second OK click is a no-op). on_cancel -> close(); closeEvent -> QWidget::closeEvent (accepted unconditionally). Window destruction destroys QProcess m_cmd, terminating the in-flight child = the build cancellation.
surfaces.notes: Courted by build-env/cancellation.

surfaces.value: ENABLE_AUR_KERNELS compile flag (meson aur_kernels option, default false); requires /sbin/paru AND /sbin/awk (flip at 5b075dc: was OR, now AND)
surfaces.notes: paru --aur -Sl | grep ' linux[^ ]*-headers' | awk '{print $2}'; dedup against repo kernels; version 'unknown-version'; raw 'aur/<name>'; install: makepkg -sicf --cleanbuild --skipchecksums (non-escalated).

surfaces.value: sched-ext button hidden unless /sys/kernel/sched_ext/state exists
surfaces.notes: Button opens scxctl::SchedExtWindow from scxctl-ui (external lib; org.scx.Loader D-Bus).

surfaces.value: Title 'CachyOS Kernel Manager'; tree columns Check/PkgName/Version/Category/Displayed/Immutable (last two hidden); buttons: sched-ext scheduler config, Configure, Cancel, Execute; ok disabled until change; space/double-click toggle current leaf item
surfaces.notes: Installed+current-repo kernels: checked + Immutable='true'. Installed from different repo: row present, unchecked, no immutable marker. Change list semantics: unchecked-immutable -> remove; checked-not-installed -> install; same list drives install and remove phases.
